title: Jesse Stone's songs Idaho and WPA
summary: Goodwin recalls Stone wrote Idaho and WPA and now writes and arranges for a New York publisher.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: He wrote a number by the name of "Idaho".
"Beyond the Hills of Idaho" that Goodman recorded?
That's the "Idaho" that Benny Goodman recorded, "Beyond the Hills of Idaho", which was a big, big hit.
That's the number "WPA", that Ella Fitzgerald did the classic recording on and the government said they couldn't put it on the air anymore. He was a hell of a writer.

Numerous numbers but those two numbers stand out in my mind because they were both big hits. They were recorded by big stars and there were several more that were recorded. Incidentally now, Jesse Stone is doing mostly writing and arranging in New York. I forget now, I can't recall what company he is with but he is with a very big company.
